title: cenchrus echinatus var. tribuloides
intro: Cenchrus echinatus var. tribuloides, commonly known as the Spiked Millet or Tribuloid Spiked Millet, is a plant species belonging to the family Poaceae. It is used in traditional medicine to treat various health conditions, including reducing stress and anxiety, promoting sleep, and alleviating symptoms of insomnia and restlessness, due to its reported health benefits. The therapeutic actions of Cenchrus echinatus var. tribuloides include sedative, anxiolytic, and hypnotic properties, attributed to its bioactive constituents, which include alkaloids, flavonoids, and saponins. However, more research is needed to confirm the efficacy and safety of Cenchrus echinatus var. tribuloides as a therapeutic agent.
